name: Acceptance suite-3 test 75 (NotEquals twin) - == A / != A across legs prevent correlation
note: IAM-1006 iteration-3 (F1): the modify leg pins aws:PrincipalAccount == 123456789012 while the assume leg requires aws:PrincipalAccount != 123456789012. A single principal cannot be both == A and != A, so the chain is unsatisfiable. The engine must model the exact-equality NEGATION (StringNotEquals) in the satisfiability check - harvesting only the positive == pin would leave the account key with a single constraint and fabricate a false CRITICAL ROLE-TAKEOVER no principal can execute. The standalone modification capabilities remain (reported, not hidden), and both condition expressions are preserved.
